Both commands pass.

```
npm run test:ac   →  Test Files 1 passed (1) | Tests 8 passed (8)
npm run build     →  tsc -b clean, built in 247ms
```

**What I built**

- `src/App.tsx` — the app: add (Enter via form submit, trimmed, empty ignored), toggle, delete, active-count, and all/active/completed filters. Every contract `data-testid` is present.
- `src/todos.ts` — types plus the pure helpers: localStorage load/save with a validating parse, id allocation, filtering, active count.

**Two things the tests specified that the contract doesn't**

- **AC-07 — persistence.** The test cleans up and re-renders `<App />`, expecting the list and each item's checked state to survive. So state loads from `localStorage` in a lazy initializer and writes back in an effect. The load path validates shape and swallows parse/quota errors, falling back to an empty list.
- **AC-08 — accessible names.** It queries by role with `name: /\S/`, so `todo-input` and each `todo-toggle` needed real accessible names — added as `aria-label` ("할 일 입력", `"<제목> 완료"`); the delete button got a matching one for consistency.

I stayed inside `src/App.tsx` and the one file below it. No changes to `tests/ac/**` (run-only), the frozen scripts, `tsconfig.app.json`, or either CSS file — and nothing from the out-of-scope list was built.
